gaps.observed_condition: The platform allocation-length decision is retained in a testable completion seam; target-specific constants remain separate and require cross-host review.
gaps.required_action: Retain separate Unix and Windows manifests and review target applicability; do not combine target denominators.
gaps.closure_basis: The exact clean cross-host snapshot retains separate Linux and Windows manifests and reports target-specific denominators.

gaps.observed_condition: The Windows focused run cannot exercise Unix statvfs counter-ordering failures.
gaps.required_action: Run the stable profile on a clean Unix target and review the Unix-specific invalid-counter tests.
gaps.closure_basis: The clean x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu stable profile exercised the Unix invalid-counter tests and closed its emitted line, region, and function metrics.

gaps.observed_condition: Several native API failure outcomes require controlled OS fault injection or a reviewed platform test harness.
gaps.required_action: Add a reviewed fault-injection seam or record a platform-specific test disposition with independent review; retain every failed or indeterminate attempt.

gaps.observed_condition: Provider discovery and unavailable-HRESULT behavior depend on the Windows API surface present on the host.
gaps.required_action: Run on the supported Windows matrix and retain the API version, host, and provider outcome in the run manifest.

gaps.observed_condition: The local evidence set cannot execute the configured aarch64-apple-darwin native coverage profiles.
gaps.required_action: Retain the strict CI matrix gate and produce clean stable, branch, and condition-instrumentation manifests on the configured macOS Apple-silicon runner.

gaps.observed_condition: The repository has no approved MC/DC basis, assigned software level, qualified-tool determination, or authority acceptance record.
gaps.required_action: Obtain and record the applicable approved basis and tool/independence decisions before considering any MC/DC or certification claim.

closure_rules: An open gap cannot be covered by a percentage threshold alone.
Cross-host closure requires separate manifests and separate applicability review.
Native failure closure requires a deterministic test or an explicit reviewed disposition.
MC/DC status remains not_assessed until an approved basis and tool-assurance decision exist.
non_claims: The observed metrics came from dirty focused-only runs and are not release evidence.
The historical focused metrics are superseded by the clean local snapshot.
The clean local snapshot is disposable internal evidence and does not satisfy the configured macOS matrix.
The branch metric is diagnostic branch coverage, not MC/DC.
The condition-instrumentation profile does not provide an independent condition total.
